column1: # Every operation of testdata/openapi-v3.snapshot.json has one verdict here
# Columns, tab-separated: operation, verdict, count, reason.
#   operation  "VERB /path" exactly as the snapshot names it, or a prefix
#              rule "VERB /path*" whose VERB may be *. A rule covers every
#              operation it matches that no exact row names; two rules
#              matching one operation is a failure, not a precedence.
#   verdict    used         the client calls it; the reason names each
#                           Client.Method whose Call literal is bound to it
#              gated        as used, for a tool only a flag registers
#              deferred     not called yet; the reason says when or why
#              written-off  never called; the reason says why
#   count      how many operations the row covers: 1 for an exact row,
#              the gate's own count for a rule
#   reason     at least a sentence; "phase N: tool" for the tools §8 plans
# A new operation from `make api-diff` fails the gate until it has a row
# or falls under a rule, and a rule whose count moved fails until the
# count is corrected here, which is when somebody reads what it now covers.
# Phase 0: what the client calls now
